data.text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY

12 March 2026

TRAFFIC DISRUPTIONS EXPECTED FOR THE 5.6 KM JPMORGAN CORPORATE CHALLENGE

The Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department (JMPD) wants to inform the community and road users of major traffic disruptions on Thursday, 12 March 2026, due to the 5.6 km JP Morgan Corporate Challenge.

This popular event will be held in the Rosebank, Illovo, Melrose Birdhaven, and Birnam areas, with around 14,000 athletes expected to participate.

The race will start at 18:30 at Venus Street and Wingfield Ave and will end at the Wanderers Sports Club.

To ensure safety during the event, road closures will be in place from 08:00 to 21:00. The affected roads include:

- M1 South and North On and Off Ramps
- Corlett Drive
- Athol-Oaklands Road
- Cross Street
- Irene Road
- Jacobs Ave
- Atherstone Road
- Melrose Blvd
- Kerknick Ave
- Venus Street
- Greenacres Drive
- Wingfield Ave
- St Andrew Road
- Ravenswood Ave
- Bute Ave
- Arran Ave
- Tyrwhitt Ave
- Rudd Road
- Jellicoe Ave
- Tottenham Ave
- Edgewood Ave
- Glenhove Road
- Cecil Ave
- Jameson Ave
- 5th Street
- Somerville Ave
- Wrenrose Ave
- Reform Ave
- Victoria Ave

JMPD officers will be on-site to help with traffic control and ensure the safety of participants and spectators. We request that all drivers stay patient and plan their routes accordingly.

Ends

Issued by the Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department Communication Unit ##SaferJoburg #JoburgRoadSafety #JHBTRAFFIC

data.text:
MAHALAGANG ABISO, QCITIZENS! 🏢

Ipatutupad sa mga kawani ng Quezon City Government ang four-day on-site workweek (Martes hanggang Biyernes), habang ang Lunes ay work-from-home day, alinsunod sa Memorandum Circular No. 114 ng Malacañang bilang suporta sa energy conservation efforts ng ating pamahalaan.

Gayunpaman, mananatili ang normal na operasyon ng mga tanggapan ng ating lokal na pamahalaan mula 8:00 AM hanggang 5:00 PM (Lunes hanggang Biyernes), at ang mga naghahatid ng serbisyong medikal, law enforcement, traffic management, disaster at emergency response, at iba pang essential services, upang matiyak ang patuloy na paghahatid ng serbisyo sa QCitizens.

📌 PAALALA:
